correctness.rationale: For four ordered distinct reports with gaps x,y,z>0, each three-facility triple omits one agent. Its four Product-Gap weights are yz,(x+y)z,x(y+z),xy summing 2(xy+xz+yz), and corresponding nearest-facility costs are x,min(x,y),min(y,z),z. Hence E=[2xyz+z(x+y)min(x,y)+x(y+z)min(y,z)]/[2(xy+xz+yz)]; OPT_3=min(x,y,z) because some facility must serve a pair and selecting all but one member of a minimum gap attains the bound. For m=x, N/x≤5yz+xz<5(xy+xz+yz); m=y gives N/y=4xz+xy+yz<5H; m=z is mirror. Thus E/OPT<5/2 strictly for all distinct profiles. The family (ε,1,1) yields (5+ε)/(2(1+2ε))→5/2, establishing sharp but nonattained supremum. Independently enumerated the four selected triples and verified exact formulas for all 30³=27000 integer gap triples and four rational epsilon values, but the algebraic case split is the infinite proof.
